scope.hardware: 4x NVIDIA B300 as two TP2 replicas
scope.placement: four concurrent requests per TP2 replica
scope.prefix_cache: four distinct warmed prefixes per replica

contract.hypothesis: Both TP2 replicas can complete four heavily cached long-context requests at the same time without OOM, request errors, or runtime failure.
contract.quality_gate: Eight valid streaming responses with valid usage and no errors at each input size.
contract.stop_rule: Stop escalation after OOM, runtime failure, or severe queueing.
contract.cleanup: Retain the production runtimes and close the temporary SSH tunnel.

100k.measurement_path: workstation through SSH tunnel; treat latency as an upper bound

250k.measurement_path: workstation through SSH tunnel; treat latency as an upper bound

500k.measurement_path: benchmark clients on the RunPod host through localhost

invalid_arms.reason: A 0.01-second launch window allowed only seven measured workers to start.
invalid_arms.action: Repeated with a one-second launch window.

invalid_arms.reason: Workstation clients uploaded about 22 MB of request JSON through two SSH tunnels. This added 60 to 74 seconds of transport delay.
invalid_arms.action: Repeated with both benchmark clients on the RunPod host.

observations: All 24 valid measured requests completed without an error or OOM.
Both runtimes were healthy with zero running and zero waiting requests after the test.
The valid 500K p95 TTFT was below 4.7 seconds on both replicas.
The invalid SSH-tunnel result was caused by request upload time, not model inference.
A separate 500K localhost test at concurrency one had 1.42-second TTFT and 161.78 decode tokens per second.
The valid 500K arm did not produce a new JIT warning.
Replica 1 compiled BuildPrefillChunkMetadataKernel during an earlier long-context arm.
limits: The valid 500K test used localhost on the RunPod host. It did not measure the public gateway or OpenRouter request-upload path.
Each size has one valid measured wave. The result establishes function and current latency, not a long-term tail distribution.
The warmup cost is excluded from measured TTFT.
next_measurement: Test 500K through the public gateway from a client with normal upload bandwidth.
